_doc: SEED in-game blend surface for NBA -- HAND-SEEDED, NOT a proven edge.
_honest_note: These weights are a reasonable prior for how much realized live state (score + clock) should pull the calibrated pregame prior. They are a STARTING POINT to be validated / refit out-of-sample by scripts/platformkit/ingame fit_w_surface (the proof agent), fit on one season and evaluated on a DIFFERENT season. No dollar edge is claimed. Markets are efficient; the only validated in-game lever is FRESHNESS (variance must shrink as fraction_elapsed rises). A correct reprice trusts the live state MORE as the game progresses (w rises toward late/large-margin cells).
_grid_doc: grid keyed 'time_bucket,margin_bucket'. time_bucket 0=Q1 (early) -> 3=Q4 (late). margin_bucket 0=tight -> 4=blowout. w in [0,1]: 0 trusts pregame prior, 1 trusts realized live state. SEED rises with both elapsed time and |margin| -- the validated freshness shape, deliberately under-resolved.
_variance_doc: Live-state variance scales with remaining fraction (Brownian score anchor): var ~ var_pregame * remaining_frac. As fraction_elapsed rises, remaining_frac falls, so the repriced variance SHRINKS (Q1 wide -> Q4 tight). This monotone shrink is an asserted invariant, not a fitted target.
